newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to lower, eyes on winter.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to lower, eyes on winter.

text.p: NWE oil products ended steady to lower but fuel oil traders saw demand ahead of winter and naphtha traders watched colder U.S. weather.
Gas oil premiums sagged $2 on good Russian supply and fears of a supply overhang from the Nov IPE contract.
Fuel oil prices were steady on Tuesday, but many traders continued to see bullish fundamentals going into the winter despite a fall in U.S. arbitrage demand.
Gasoline ended steady in quiet trade. A rise in the U.K. petrol tax by three pence a liter was expected.
Naphtha trimmed its losses after crude rebounded.
